title: Evidence B core: terminal execution union and imported-verification applicability
outcome: Evidence B core: terminal execution union and imported-verification applicability
acceptance: A keyed execution union holds supported authoritative terminal bodies from both original terminal-origin and association request records, including ResultConflict and refused associations; behavior tests deliver equivalent different-id and conflicting same-store and cross-store records in both orders, and one execution is never counted twice.

A local applicability decision on an imported record has its own identity, distinguishes origin assurance from local observation, and qualifies only through the common qualifier with equal complete source identity; commit, tree, changes or submodule drift, an unmatched Git carrier commit and a failed aggregate don't qualify, and no new host, environment or rerun condition is added.

Reported gates, observation-embedded uncredited checks, unsupported or provisional bodies and malformed provenance never become observed verification; exact original bytes, results, times and host provenance stay unchanged, and a transaction rollback leaves no partial satisfaction.
Shared ledger, reducer, view, data-worktree and service wiring stay on w-365c2dad40cf, w-7413b4728667 and w-4eabb205c7b2; this item's part of them is an agreed seam only.
